name: Bar²
author: kamal
description: Empty second bar that mirrors the default bar — start empty, move widgets from the main bar to fill it. Two modes: full-edge (reserves space) and floating shrunk (configurable width). Control is a single ◧ button in the main bar.

barWidget.description: Single ◧ button in the main bar that opens the Bar² control panel. Keep this in the main bar to operate Bar².
